messages:
leo: Heads-up: PR needs new SDK snippets for resumable streaming + pagination retries. CI flagged the python example as using old args.

maya: Which file?

leo: docs/sdk/examples/streaming_retrieval.md — currently shows a naive streaming loop. We need: resumeToken usage, cursor_ttl note, and short retry example for 429s. Also a fix for a broken internal link.

fern: I can do TS+Go. I'll show an idiomatic async iterator (for await) and a Go example with context cancellation and channel streaming.

leo: Thanks. tara, can you take Python and a tiny pytest mocking resume behavior? Product prefers mentioning cursor_ttl=5m.

tara: On it. Python draft will use `with client.responses.stream_generate(...) as s:` and demonstrate catching ClientRateLimitError -> backoff -> resume using page.resume_token.

ci-bot: lint error: broken link at line 28 -> /api/v1/old-stream.

fern: I'll also include a small TS retry helper that wraps async iterator and retries once on 5xx/429 with exponential backoff.

maya: Add a single-sentence migration note in changelog: old->new call shapes and why resumable streams help large RAG flows. Also mention batching embeddings to save tokens.

tara: Timeline: Python + test PR today, TS+Go PR tomorrow morning.

leo: Perfect. Ping @docs when PRs are ready and I'll run the doc linter.

ci-bot: reminder: request reviewers @doc-team @sdk-team
